entries.1903ceb04d1d2f9f: Licenses for mobile services and others
entries.5c135e13021c163c: It plans, produces, develops and sells game software centered on role-playing games.
entries.6d4f7b7bab364570: This is a single-segment business that plans, produces, develops and sells game software.
entries.7fe5b84b94148e74: A game company that plans and develops role-playing games such as "Ys" and "The Legend of Heroes" in-house, and earns revenue from sales and license grants.
entries.8a71353ea56246b3: Development and sales licenses for game software
entries.9bfef9f63a64f7f2: It grants licenses for its own game software and game music, including development and sales licenses for software for domestic home game consoles, localization and region-limited sales licenses for overseas markets, licenses for mobile services and download sales, and licenses for the production and sale of books and other publications, and earns royalty income from upfront contract payments and running royalties.
entries.a7ef50ebdf0c85cc: Game companies and others that are licensees
entries.a9cfc5d9c105fe00: This is a single-segment business that plans, produces, develops and sells game software. It operates through two divisions, the Product Division and the License Division, and revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥2,612 million. Its head office is located in Tachikawa, Tokyo, and its only business location is the head office (1 location). It had 69 employees as of September 30, 2025.
entries.bedabd5d72b5d11c: It plans, produces, develops and sells game software centered on role-playing games. It also produces and sells Japanese-language versions of game software licensed from overseas game software companies, and plans, produces and sells music CDs. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥731 million.
entries.c0c7508ccc64e03a: Localization and sales licenses for overseas markets
entries.e2fa9731d636d1a4: It grants licenses for its own game software and game music, including development and sales licenses for software for domestic home game consoles, localization and region-limited sales licenses for overseas markets, licenses for mobile services and download sales, and licenses for the production and sale of books and other publications, and earns royalty income from upfront contract payments and running royalties. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥1,881 million.
